content: Browser storage limits (MDN + web.dev agree): localStorage/sessionStorage about 5MB each per origin, synchronous string-only, blocks main thread, unavailable inside service workers. IndexedDB stores structured data AND File/Blob blobs via structured clone with huge quotas (Chrome up to 60 percent of disk), async, accessible from workers and service workers; use idb promise wrapper. File objects lose name/lastModified on serialization so store metadata separately. navigator.storage.persist() prevents best-effort eviction; Safari caps writable storage at 7 days of non-use except installed PWAs. web.dev guidance: Cache Storage for app shell assets, IndexedDB for data, OPFS for file-based content.
